title: Handoff Chronicle: Week of 2027-04-07 — ops & SLO pulse
content:
Purpose: quick, readable handoff for the week of Apr 7. Collates incidents, SLO trends, short-term mitigations, runbook edits, and who to ping next. This is a working note — take from it what you need and add items at the bottom.

High-level summary:
- Overall: steady but noisy week. Two mid-severity incidents, modest SLO burn on generation p99 for EU region during an upstream model rollout, several quick runbook improvements pushed.
- Incident count: 2 incidents (one production latency spike, one degraded metrics ingestion). No SEV1.
- Error budget: generation p99 for EU cluster used ~4.1% of monthly budget this week (above expected cadence). Frontline SLOs (control-plane API availability) within target.

Incidents (concise):
1) Incident SRE-4521: EU generation p99 spike — Apr 06 22:15 UTC
   - Symptom: p99 generation latency jumped from baseline ~340ms to 2.1s for ~38 minutes, affecting approx 12% of requests to model-rw-13b-v2 in eu-west-1.
   - Immediate mitigations: roll back to model-rw-13b-v1 via routing fallback (automatic policy triggered), increased autoscale headroom by 25% for dedicated pool, temporarily disabled a recently-introduced KV-cache size reduction flag.
   - Root-cause (initial triage): model variant introduced wider activation distributions; runtime kernel selection produced higher memory churn causing increased GC/eviction behavior in local KV cache. Cache thrashing + slightly smaller batch windows resulted in serialization delays.
   - Actions taken: revert rollout (done), re-opened model onboarding ticket for better load profile tests (JIRA-SRE-4589), restored previous KV cache sizing, added temporary circuit-breaker to limit long-tail requests to canary fleet.
   - Next steps: schedule controlled replay of failing traces against the model in staging (owner: Zoe Park, JIRA-SRE-4589), add a pre-rollout KV-cache stress test to model onboarding checklist (owner: Maya Chen), add Grafana alert for sudden p99 ratio > 3x baseline.

2) Incident: metrics-ingest partial delay — Apr 05 09:40 UTC
   - Symptom: ~45 minute delay in metrics ingestion pipeline for node_exporter metrics; some SLO dashboards showed stale data. No user-facing impact.
   - Cause: ElasticSearch ingest throughput reduced after bump to retention snapshot; transient backlog in the metrics-consumer causing retries.
   - Mitigation: manually increased consumer concurrency, cleared backlog, promoted backlog drain job.
   - Permanent fix: throttle snapshot writes during daytime retention jobs; long-term: separate metrics-critical index from heavy retention indices. (Owner: Liam Patel, JIRA-SRE-4527).

SLO & metrics snapshot:
- generation-success-rate: 99.992% (within monthly target 99.9%)
- generation-p95 latency: 420ms (target 500ms)
- generation-p99 latency: 1.08s (target 900ms) — note: p99 drifted due to the EU incident and remains the primary risk for month-end burn.
- control-plane availability: 99.995% (on target)
- incident MTTR this week: median 28 min

Runbook and tooling updates (quick list):
- KV cache sizing runbook updated with a new checklist and a 2-step rollback test. File: CONFLUENCE-2382 (edit pushed by Maya).
- Added a new Grafana panel: p99-tail-ratio-by-region (owner: Diego).
- Model onboarding checklist: inserted 'replay historical sequences with 95th+ length' gate. (owner: Zoe Park).

On-call handoff notes (to next shift):
- Hot dashboards: SLO pulse (https://grafana.redwood-infra/board/slo-pulse), generation-p99-by-region, autoscale-queue-depth.
- Bridges: #sre-ops (Slack), oncall-bridge (Zoom link in runbook). If you hit an alert with p99>2x baseline AND error-rate>0.1% open bridge immediately.
- Temporary flags in prod: kv-cache-sizing=restored-by-rollback, generation-fallback-enabled=true. If you see errors tied to kv eviction, do not flip cache sizing flags without confirming with Zoe.
- Escalation path: senior-sre -> eng-oncall -> oncall-lead (see CONFLUENCE-2382 for numbers).

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Maya: add pre-rollout KV stress tests to model onboarding checklist (due 2027-04-14, JIRA-SRE-4589).
- Zoe: run controlled replay of failing traces and validate kernel selections (due 2027-04-12, linked PR/test job to be created).
- Liam: split metrics-critical index and implement daytime-write-throttle prototype (due 2027-04-21, JIRA-SRE-4527).
- Diego: implement and instrument p99-tail-ratio-by-region panel + alert (due 2027-04-09).
- Oncall team: perform a short runbook walkthrough this Friday 10:00 PT (owner: Maya).

Quick wins (to reduce noise):
- Lower the noise threshold on ephemeral infra alerts (reduce false positives from autoscale flapping). Short PR proposed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/312 (review appreciated).
- Add a one-liner to the oncall welcome doc: how to check for KV eviction logs (owner: Liam).

Open questions / research items:
- Should we adopt a per-model warm cache policy for long-tail sequence distributions? Pros: fewer cold misses. Cons: memory footprint increase — need cost analysis. (Spike owner: Priya Nair — placeholder).
- Are there kernel-selection knobs we can expose as safe feature flags to quickly revert problematic paths? Needs engineering discussion.

Notes to next oncall (handy shortcuts):
- To check p99 anomalies quickly: run 'scripts/slo_pulse quick-check --metric generation.p99 --window 1h --by-region'.
- To validate runbook step: 'runbook verify kv-cache-rollback --env prod --dry-run'.
- Slack threads to scan: #prod-ops (last 72h), #model-onboarding (check Apr 4–7), /search for JIRA-SRE-4521 for trace links.

Retrospective ask (for the week):
- Small, focused retrospective on SRE response to model rollout on Apr 8 11:00 PT (15–20m). Bring metrics dashboards and trace slices. Goal: concrete adjustments to rollout gating.

Appendix: notable logs & artifacts
- trace-slices: link from JIRA-SRE-4521 (see linked_artifacts).
- provisional notes from Diego on cache eviction pattern: "evictions spike when activation variance > 3x baseline; also correlated with smaller batch windows" — Diego will formalize and push notes to CONFLUENCE-2382.

Additions welcome: if you debug something, paste the short summary at the bottom and mark owner. This doc is intended to be a living handoff record for the week.

-- Maya
